lessons_used: Predictions remain consistently too high relative to measured results across most tests.
For home redesign changes, 3 tests agree on positive noise-corrected lift, but no clear effect was seen as none reached significance.

Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy changes because the 2 test results disagree after noise correction (+2.8% vs -3.5%).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in hint changes because the 2 test results disagree after noise correction (-1.0% vs +3.9%), despite one test winning.
Adoption redesign and sign_in hint are the only kinds of change that proved helpful (won), though evidence remains thin for single-test categories.
